messages:
deploy-bot: Candidate created: build-20260318-42 for service=redwood-runtime, candidate_id=cand-20260318-42. Digest: sha256:9f2a... Link: <https://ci.redwood/reports/cand-20260318-42>

amanda_rm: Cutting candidate now. Target promo window 2026-03-19 01:00 UTC -> 03:00 UTC. Change advisory posted.

priya_qa: Smoke plan uploaded: https://docs.redwood/rc/smoketests/cand-20260318-42. Key tests: tokenization, KV cache warmup, batch throughput, slow-path fallback.

josh_engrel: Pinning artifacts: model weight tag model-1.4-q4; runtime image gcr.io/redwood/runtime:20260318-42

carla_sre: Oncall rota assigned: janet_oncall covers first 90m; carla covers rollback window. Monitoring dashboards: /dashboards/rc-20260318-42

liam_pm: Can we do a 10% canary for 30m then 50% then 100%? Need to ensure latency P90 < 200ms.

amanda_rm: Plan: 10% -> 30m -> check errors & cost per token -> 50% -> 20m -> final. Rollback trigger: error rate > 1% OR P95 > 400ms for >10m. Ack if good.

tom_infra: Autoscaling policy adjusted for candidate: min_replicas=6, max_replicas=60; burst enabled.

janet_oncall: ack

carla_sre: ack

priya_qa: running preflight now. Patch logs: ```
[preflight] kv_cache warmup: OK
[preflight] sample gen (len=512): p50 58ms, p95 180ms
[preflight] embedding endpoint: passed
```

amanda_rm: releasing release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-19-candidate-42. Highlights: model pin, performance improvements, known issue: rare tokenization mismatch on edge-case unicode.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 2026-03-19T01:10:00Z -> starting canary. promote command: ```sh
./deploy promote --candidate=cand-20260318-42 --route=api.prod --canary=10% --stages=10,50,100 --wait
```

josh_engrel: kicking off.

deploy-bot: canary 10% started

josh_engrel: canary 10% -> p95 175ms, errors 0.05% :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary 30% started

josh_engrel: canary 30% -> p95 190ms, errors 0.07%

amanda_rm: no regressions, proceed to 50%

deploy-bot: canary 50% started

josh_engrel: 50% -> p95 210ms, errors 0.4% (spike on rerank path)

carla_sre: investigating rerank spike; adding extra capacity to rerank pool

josh_engrel: after scaling rerank pool p95 back to 185ms

amanda_rm: proceeding to 100% in 10m unless new alerts

janet_oncall: monitoring logs; setting alert threshold lower temporarily

deploy-bot: promotion complete -> 100% traffic routed to cand-20260318-42. Digest pinned.

liam_pm: noting prod release in changelog and slack #announcements

amanda_rm: post-deploy checklist: run regression evals, notify customers, verify billing meters. Priya, please run regression suite now.

priya_qa: regression suite started. ETA 20m.

priya_qa: regression done. No quality regressions found. Passing.

carla_sre: creating rollback artifact just in case: pinned previous build build-20260310-37

amanda_rm: official signoff: GO. Thanks team :tada:

josh_engrel: will close the incident and update release notes with final metrics.

deploy-bot: thread archived.
